tasks.short: Plan and revise history curricula and teaching materials.

steps.what: Retrieve current curriculum, historical sources and actual course evaluation evidence
Evaluate curriculum and select learning outcomes, historical content and instructional methods
Write revised course descriptions and teaching materials from selected revisions

loop.input: selected revisions and actual historical source pack
loop.output: draft course descriptions and materials with references
loop.check: Teacher checks historical meaning, chronology, source interpretation, learning alignment and omitted qualifications
loop.stop: Unsupported historical assertions or two failed revisions require manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native headings and reusable fields first; variable historical explanations need bounded prose

steps.what: Check the complete final curriculum materials and alignment
Save the checked final curriculum materials

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} course views and {DOCS} revision fields, then bounded drafting of teacher-selected revisions. Teacher retains curriculum evaluation, historical judgement and complete final-material checking; no student evaluation or grade decision is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source retrieval and revision composition.
tasks.enabler_now: Native course views and source-grounded drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Historical interpretation and choosing effective teaching methods.
tasks.human_edge: Choose which perspectives and evidence students should critically examine.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated drafting; curriculum rights unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native course views and bounded prose drafting can support teacher-selected curriculum revisions without selecting learning outcomes or assessing students.

assumptions: Boundary is curriculum revision through final materials save. Course owner supplies actual outcomes and version; course-evaluation owner supplies authorised actual aggregate feedback; publishers or archives supply historical sources. Teacher resolves gaps in s1 and selects changes in s2. Missing source support requires manual writing, not invented history.

Native first; existing views earn zero. Shares provisional, unmeasured. Draft meaning review retained in s3; ordinary full-material QA10 distinct. Curriculum decisions45 and save1 unchanged. Publication or formal institutional approval is separate actual work with no claimed saving.
unknowns: Actual revision mix and permitted source access
research_questions: Can drafts preserve historical nuance and selected learning objectives?

incremental.description: Maintain source links and evaluate curriculum drafts

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked final curriculum materials

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional source20 reduced25 percent saves5 and writing24 reduced30 percent saves7.2 minus1.5 upkeep=10.7; half eligible preparation gives4.6. Curriculum judgement45, final QA10 and save1 unchanged.

tasks.short: Select and obtain history teaching materials and supplies.

steps.what: Inspect candidate textbooks and supplies against actual teaching requirements
Check editions, availability, price and permitted course use
Choose materials and justified quantities within actual authority
Enter and check the final internal materials requisition
Submit the checked final requisition to purchasing

tasks.design: Configure native {PROCUREMENT} catalogue favourites and requisition fields. Teacher evaluates content and current editions and checks actual quantities and terms before internal requisition submission; purchasing retains supplier ordering and fulfilment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated requisition details for known teaching materials.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue reuse and requisition defaults.
tasks.still_hard: Content suitability, edition changes and actual course-use rights.
tasks.human_edge: Choose historically sound materials appropriate to students.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated requisition entry; material choice unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native procurement favourites can reuse material identifiers without choosing textbooks or confirming current rights and availability.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher selection and obtaining materials via actual internal purchasing handoff; supplier fulfilment is not teacher labour. Supplier or library catalogue supplies identifier, edition, price, availability and terms. Teacher verifies terms in s2 and chooses quantities in s3, then enters cost code and delivery details in s4. Missing catalogue data is manually entered; purchase approval and supplier order remain actual purchasing work, not inferred completion.

Native first. Provisional requisition19 applies where teacher actually enters order details; existing auto-fill earns zero. Evaluation45, terms20, selection15 and submit1 unchanged. No extra approval step added; normal complete requisition check gates submission.
unknowns: Actual acquisition route and current catalogue reuse
research_questions: Which requisition details repeat after textbook selection?

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked final internal materials requisition

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional requisition19 reduced20 percent saves3.8 minus0.5 upkeep=3.3; half eligible repeated requisitions gives1.4. Content45, terms20, choice15 and submission1 unchanged.

tasks.short: Advise students during scheduled office hours.

steps.what: Open the student's actual question, submitted work or course requirements during the appointment
Listen, explain history concepts and advise the student on actual learning difficulties
outputs: actual advising exchange and next steps

steps.what: Record and check actual study guidance in the existing student feedback field
inputs: actual advising exchange and next steps

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} links from the student question to the actual work and course requirements. Keep the actual advising conversation and feedback writing human; the existing feedback field already handles its small record step.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation to actual student work during advice.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding what the student has misunderstood and giving useful guidance.
tasks.human_edge: Listen and adapt explanations to the student's actual understanding.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less navigation during advice; teaching responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native learning-system submission links reduce navigation while office-hours teaching and actual feedback remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is the actual appointment and feedback already written there. Student supplies actual question and work; course owner supplies current requirements. Teacher opens them in s1, manually finds missing material and records actual guidance in s3. No recurring office-hours scheduling, preparation report or compulsory new note baseline is invented; if no feedback is normally written, reweight from actual observation.

Native first; already-linked submissions earn zero new saving. Provisional lookup5 only during actual appointment, conversation90 and existing feedback4 retain full time; save1 retained. Ordinary feedback writing/checking provides the gate, no extra note approval step.
unknowns: Actual navigation and existing feedback practice
research_questions: Does a native submission link remove navigation during real appointments?

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete checked actual advising feedback

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional appointment lookup5 reduced40 percent saves2 minus0.25 upkeep=1.75; half eligible appointments gives0.75. Conversation90, actual feedback4 and save1 unchanged.

tasks.short: Review historical books and articles for publication.

steps.what: Read the actual manuscript and inspect its historical evidence and references
Judge originality, historical argument, evidence quality and publication suitability
Write and check the final review using the publisher's existing review form
Submit the final review to the designated editor

tasks.design: Use the existing {PARTNER_PORTAL} review form and approved manuscript access. Actual reading, publication judgement and review writing remain human; the existing form already removes repeated layout and a model is not needed for confidential review.
tasks.previous_blocker: No unconfigured repeated step established in the actual peer-review workflow.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing native review form already supplies structure.
tasks.still_hard: Evaluating historical argument and the adequacy of source interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Provide an independent, fair and defensible scholarly judgement.
tasks.altitude: No change to review workload or decision rights.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: publisher review forms already structure reviewer reports; actual scholarly reading and publication assessment are not eliminated by the form.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual manuscript reading, recommendation, written review and external submission. Publisher supplies actual manuscript revision, questions and assignment recipient; reviewer resolves references manually in s1 and writes actual critique in s3. No generated source verification or free manuscript extraction.

Native first found the existing review form sufficient. Actual writing19 and submit1 explicitly separated before zero; no extra self-approval ritual. No configuration change means zero incremental upkeep justified. Shares provisional, not measured; editor's final publication decision is separate and no saving is claimed.
unknowns: Actual review form and confidentiality restrictions
research_questions: Is any repeated clerical work left after the existing native review form?

incremental.description: No new component or configuration to maintain

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete checked final publication review for assigned editor and manuscript

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All provisional100 units retained after separating actual reading65, recommendation15, writing19 and submission1. Existing native form needs no change and no upkeep; no new saving established.
